rules.statement: When a change introduces or relies on a new convention, a non-obvious design decision, or a recurring tooling gotcha, record it in the repository's versioned docs (scoped instruction files for conventions, an ADR for the reasoning, the agent/contributor guide for build or orientation knowledge) in the same change, not only in chat, a wiki, personal notes, or agent memory.
rules.why: Knowledge kept only in volatile memory or external docs is unversioned and unreviewable, so it drifts from the code and gets re-learned over and over. Repository files are reviewed and versioned together with the code they describe.
rules.check: Look for diffs that set up a new pattern or rule, or work around a quirk in a non-obvious way, without updating the instruction files, ADRs, or AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING docs. Also flag PR descriptions or comments that point to a rule existing only in chat history, a wiki, or someone's memory.
